s.how: Butter thick slices of sourdough on the outside. Fill with grated gruyere and cheddar. Cook in a pan over medium heat for 3 minutes a side, pressing down, until golden and melting. Cut into fingers and serve to anyone who has just come home very late from work.

Top 16 blinis with creme fraiche, smoked salmon and snipped chives. Halve 6 fresh figs, top each with goat's cheese and a drizzle of honey. Arrange both in neat rows on a white platter, as sharp as a front row seat.

m.note: Andy rushing out to get Miranda's steak for lunch
m.how: Roast 1kg potato chunks at 220C for 45 minutes. Sear 4 sirloin steaks in a smoking pan, baste with butter and garlic and rest. Wilt 300g spinach and simmer with 150ml cream until thick. Serve sliced, exactly when expected. That's all.

w.how: Blind bake a sweet shortcrust case and cool. Fill with 500ml thick custard and pile 250g blueberries on top. Warm apricot jam with a splash of water and brush over to glaze. Dust the edge with icing sugar. The colour was chosen for you years ago.

d.note: Andy fetching Miranda's coffee every morning
d.how: Pull a double shot of strong espresso into each cup and add an extra shot on top. Steam milk until silky and pour in. Serve hot and on time, because a cold one will be sent back without a word.
